depiction.primary_object: circle with one filled one-eighth pie wedge at top right
depiction.composition: single circular gauge or pie diagram, front view

readings.meaning: elapsed time / timer / clock face (~7-8 minutes)

ambiguity: Reads interchangeably as a pie chart, a 1/8 progress indicator, a clock or timer slice, or a moon/shadow phase; distinct from standard segmented pie charts only because the outer ring is continuous.
task_intents: create a pie chart of expenses

reasoning: Shows a circle with a single 1/8th filled sector, which is part of a progress/time-slice series (1/8, 2/8, etc.) often used as a status badge rather than a task subject. When used as a subject icon, it reads as a pie chart, percentage breakdown, or timer slice, though a classic pie chart with an offset slice is much clearer.
